label: Bible Study
prompt: But these are _____, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verse: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
note: John's purpose statement for his whole Gospel — written so you'd believe and live.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do _____ unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verse: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
note: Do good to everybody, Paul says — and especially to the household of faith.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And _____ that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
verse: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
note: Wine for gladness, oil for shining faces, bread for strength — the psalmist thanking God for a well-stocked table.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Who is the image of the _____ God, the firstborn of every creature:
verse: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
note: Want to see the unseen God? Paul points to Christ — and the next verse says all things were created by him.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I press toward the _____ for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verse: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
note: 'I press toward the mark' — Paul as a runner leaning toward the finish line, eyes off the past.
